the development and deployment of IFC in a cloud environment, to support the data management needs of cloud tenants and providers.

the development of a model and implementation of a system-wide data sharing framework that provides a basis for the secure, flexible and transparent sharing of data across the cloud, while providing the necessary guarantees of protection and compliance.
the management of data in cloud-hosted applications, in particular the enforcement of policy and the provision of transparency and auditability.

IFC offers a powerful and flexible approach to data management, which can be used to support the data management needs of cloud-hosted applications.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IFC is a powerful tool for managing data flows in a multi-tenant, multi-provider environment such as a cloud, but it requires significant changes to the underlying software and infrastructure.
we have designed and developed a model of IFC and a prototype implementation that can be deployed in the cloud.
we are able to show how to implement IFC for cloud services and how to integrate it with the cloud infrastructure and with applications, and how to manage it.

IFC is a powerful tool to help cloud providers and their tenants to manage data in a cloud-hosted environment, with benefits for both the provider and its tenants.

IFC can be deployed in the cloud, providing a system-wide, end- to-end flow control for data, and offering protection and transparency for owners and operators of cloud services, and for the data they manage.
